'''July 2000 Hastings tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hastings, MN on 15 July 2000. [[Graham Neal]] won it. It is known from Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1012">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-hastings-mn-7-15-00d1012/ hastings-mn-7-15-00], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 16 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-hastings-mn-7-15-00d1012/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Hastings, MN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Graham Neal]]
